_comment: Pipeline: Profile migration check — compare old and new profile versions, then generate shapes from the new version.
_how_to_use: Fill in REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar run pipeline-profile-migration.json
name: Profile migration check
description: Compare two RDFS profile versions to audit what changed, then generate fresh SHACL shapes from the new version.

steps.name: Compare profile versions
steps._note: Produces a diff of classes, attributes, and associations between old and new profile. Exit 0 = identical, exit 1 = differences found. The pipeline continues in both cases.
steps._note_output: Excel diff report. Review this before running the next step.

steps.name: Generate SHACL shapes from new profile
steps._note: Generates a fresh scaffold of SHACL shapes from the updated RDFS profile. Review and edit the output before using it in validation.
steps._note_rdfsFiles: The new profile files to generate shapes from.
